issues.description: Method SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal): The problem statement's UML and task description specify orderMeal should have a void return type (UML: '+orderMeal(Meal): void' and the textual description of Part 2 describing the behavior without any return value). In the solution repository, SealSaloon.orderMeal is implemented as 'public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal)'. This mismatch between 'void' (problem statement) and 'boolean' (solution) can confuse students about the expected method signature and what to return, and may cause inconsistencies with automated checks or reference implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Either: (A) Change the solution implementation to match the specification by updating the method signature to 'public void orderMeal(Meal meal)' and remove the boolean return value (ensure behavior remains the same: add meal to orders, increment totalOrders, call checkOrderReady()), or (B) If the boolean return was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to declare 'orderMeal(Meal): boolean' and document what true/false signify. Prefer option A to match the existing UML and task description.
